context: The player finds Tara, a tressym (a winged, cat‑like creature), in the Posthouse/Wyrm’s Crossing carrying a magic item and tries to persuade her to hand it over. If Gale is in the party he becomes the favoured speaker: he recognizes Tara (or at least treats her as his friend/tressym), reacts excitedly, and can identify the item and why she might have it. Tara mostly responds with catlike noises and hisses and often pretends not to speak Common, so she doesn’t answer directly. The provided samples illustrate one possible exchange but other outcomes are possible.
